articles.title: Community Managers Pilot Environmental Awareness Project in Falinge Park
articles.excerpt: Community managers of Falinge Park are launching a pilot project aimed at promoting environmental awareness and sustainability across 27 acres of public greenspace.
articles.content_html:
A group of community managers is launching a pilot project in Falinge Park, Rochdale, aimed at promoting environmental awareness and sustainability.

The initiative will focus on climate change, biodiversity, and food sustainability, utilising the 27 acres of public greenspace as a model for community engagement.

The project seeks to raise awareness about environmental issues and encourage local residents to participate in discussions and activities related to these topics.

Further details about the project and how the community can get involved will be shared in upcoming announcements.
